blocks.text: Public project: Symphony of Justice | Internal/original name: Symphonia Iustitiae
Build a single timeline for Symphony of Justice that makes it possible to organize:
events that continue to affect the present.
The timeline must serve as a common reference for:
Its main function is to prevent a character, nation, technology, organization, or event from existing before it could historically exist.
We know that A happened before B.
We know how much time passed between A and B.
At present, we possess substantial information of the first type and little of the second.
Therefore: The absence of a date must not be filled in with arbitrary estimates.
When we only know that events occurred “centuries later,” “much later,” or “during the same era,” that wording will be preserved until the calendar is defined.
To avoid inventing dates, internal codes will be used:
Each event must also indicate how much the world knows about it.
Example: The four Deities died during ancient conflicts.
The event is known, but different nations possess incompatible versions.
Example: The responsibility of each nation during ancient wars.
Production knows the truth, but the general population does not.
Example: the true circumstances surrounding the deaths of Iluminate and Arcanus.
It happened, but virtually no one in the current era remembers it.
T0-001 | Existence of the Master of Birds
The Master of Birds exists as an original entity bound to the universe itself.
The foundation exists upon which the world can later develop.
All cosmology derives indirectly from this existence.
The Master creates the world and its surroundings.

He does not create it with the intention of ruling it permanently, but with an interest in observing what can emerge when its inhabitants possess genuine freedom. This current formulation comes from recent project decisions.
The setting begins to exist in which societies, concepts, and civilizations will later appear.
6. T1 | Era of the Four Deities
T1-001 | Creation of the Deities of Judgment
Over time, they will become associated respectively with:
Ancient sources already described four siblings/deities connected to the moral pillars of the world, although several older names have been replaced by the current canon.
Their philosophies will eventually become pillars of the four major nations.
The four siblings interact with the world and develop different responses to the actions of living beings.
Followers, ideas, and traditions begin to emerge around their teachings.
This is one of the most sensitive eras in the lore because public history and true history diverge radically here.
T2-001 | Growth of the Conflict Between the Siblings
The philosophical and personal differences between the Deities cease to be merely ideological.
The Deity of Wisdom physically disappears.
Her followers will make the preservation of knowledge a central part of their identity.
The population may know of Kitsune's death, but not necessarily who was truly responsible.
The concept of Revenge does not disappear with him.
His legacy will continue to develop among beings and communities marked by:
T2-004 | Emergence of the Future God of the Writers
One of the last souls connected to the judgment of the Deities witnesses part of these events.
Arcanus allows that soul to continue existing.
The Will to preserve what truly happened without censorship or bias
will eventually transform that being into a divine entity.
Historical documentation already preserves the idea of a “child of judgment” who witnessed the murder of the deities and later founded the Writers.
One of the main mechanisms for preserving historical truth is born.
T2-005 | Early Emergence of the Shinigami
The Shinigami emerge approximately during this era.
balance between the living and the dead.
Historical documents also connect them directly to safeguarding the balance between both worlds.
T2-006 | War Between Arcanus and Iluminate
The conflict between the two surviving siblings reaches a phase of open war.
The existence of the war may be known.
Iluminate kills Shadow, a close friend of Arcanus.
His death gives Arcanus a decisive opportunity to end the confrontation.
His sacrifice will become deeply tied to future Arcane identity and to his bloodline.
A widely accepted version maintains that Arcanus and Iluminate died during their confrontation.
After the conflict, Roses, Shadow's daughter, ends Arcanus's life.
The decision has a strong relationship with the principle of equivalence and consequence that Arcanus himself defended.
The era of the four active Deities of Judgment ends.
Roses later becomes the first recognized mortal leader of the Arcane.
T2-010 | The Deities Become Bound to Purgatory
After their deaths, the four Deities do not disappear completely.
Their existences/souls remain contained within Purgatory.

T3-004 | Early Development of the Mafia
Tsuiho's legacy continues to affect communities marked by:
Ancient texts connected its origin to Tsuiho's seals and the so-called Riders.

The current formulation integrates both elements: Tsuiho's influence functions as a metaphysical and ideological seed, while different communities gradually develop the structures that will eventually form the Mafia.

The situation ultimately threatens the other major societies.
T4-002 | Coalition of the Other Three Nations

The Mafia is cornered and ultimately confined underground.
Historical texts describe how the three clans seal it beneath a mountain, forming a hive megacity contained by chains.
The sealing completely transforms Mafia society.

This era represents centuries of institutional growth.
Its exact internal order still needs to be developed.

T7-003 | Creation of the Boarding School
As a gesture of goodwill among the major clans, a Boarding School is created.
Its objective is to bring together heirs and young figures from different nations so that a future generation can come to know one another before becoming their leaders.
Historical documentation presents the Boarding School precisely as an attempt by the Ministry to create a generation capable of living together in peace.
